{{Quote|We’re at thirty percent capacity, with nine turbolaser batteries and one proton torpedo launcher still functional. Our tractor beam projectors are all down, but&mdash;|Barcelle|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
A '''proton torpedo launcher''' was an armament mounted on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] vehicle, used by a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]] and organizations to launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] during [[Army/Legends|armed]] [[List of battles/Legends|conflicts]].{{Weapon-stub}}
